pk.context: 400 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: A half-life near 1 hour, with about 60% of a dose excreted in urine within 6 to 8 hours, marks this aminopenicillin.

clues.text: It is stable in gastric acid and rapidly absorbed by mouth. About 20% is protein bound, and most of a dose is excreted unchanged in the urine.
Supplied as the trihydrate; the active moiety has a molecular weight of 365.4.
Approved under an NDA as an oral suspension of 200 or 400 mg per 5 mL; tablets and chewable tablets are also supplied.
No boxed warning; contraindicated after a serious hypersensitivity reaction to it. Diarrhea and rash are the most common reactions.
Infections of the ear, nose and throat, genitourinary tract and skin caused by susceptible bacteria.
The label describes it only as an antibacterial drug.
The generic name begins with A and has eleven letters.
